name: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited
promoterDematNotes: 150 Equity Shares held by Rupa Equities Pvt Ltd under its former name Shishir Holdings Pvt    Ltd., a promoter group company have not been dematerialized as the said shares are subject matter of injunction granted by the Hon'ble Bombay High Court in Suit No1023 of 2000 filed   by Ramanlal Vrajlal Shah & Others Vs Tarun Bhalchandra Raval & Others
remarksWeb: 1. Maharashtra Scooters Limited (PAN: AABCM1799E), which holds 3,387,036 shares of the Company, is a subsidiary covered under Section 19(1)(c) of the Companies Act, 2013. Hence, Maharashtra Scooters Limited does not exercise voting rights on the shares held by it.  2. In terms of the Order of Honble Bombay High Court dated 16 January 2020, read with the modified Order dated 30 January 2020 in I.A. No. 1 of 2020 in Petition No. 2972 of 2018, Ms. Pooja Bajaj acting in her capacity as the mother and natural guardian of her minor son, Vanraj Bajaj, has offered an undertaking that the shares as referred to hereunder, being the 1/3rd share that will come to the share of Vanraj Bajaj from and out of the estate of his deceased father, Mr. Anant Bajaj shall be kept aside and not dealt with during the minority of Vanraj Bajaj, without the prior leave of the Honble Court - 334 Equity shares of the Company, being the 1/3rd share that will come to Vanraj Bajaj from and out of the shares presently held by the estate of his deceased father, Mr. Anant Bajaj; and Pooja Bajaj, in her capacity as the mother and natural guardian of Vanraj Bajaj had given the undertakings as aforesaid with a view to securing Vanrajs 1/3rd share in the estate of his deceased father, Mr. Anant Bajaj.  In pursuance of the foregoing, Ms. Pooja Bajaj has, on 18 February 2020, submitted an Affidavit containing the undertakings as aforesaid to the Honble Court. The Honble Court has vide its Order dated 26 February 2020, accepted the undertakings as aforesaid.  In the circumstances, the aforesaid shares of the Company cannot be dealt with or disposed-off until Vanraj Bajaj attains majority or during his minority, without obtaining the prior leave of the Honble Court. Therefore, these shares are not pledged with the depository but are to be treated as 'encumbered otherwise'.

Hercules Hoists Ltd. had      acquired 4,829 shares on 27 March 2023 and 3,500 shares on 29 March 2023,      through open market transactions. The Company had also received FORM-C      under SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, from Hercules      Hoists Ltd., informing about the aforesaid acquisitions. Hence, the      Company has included these 8,329 shares in the name of Hercules Hoists Ltd.      in the SHP for the quarter ended 31 March 2023 even though the said shares      are not reflected in depositories data as on 31 March 2023.        Consequent upon the sad demise      of Shri Rahulkumar Bajaj, Promoter, of BHIL Shri Sanjivnayan Bajaj and      Rajivnayan Bajaj have been included in the Promoter from Promoter      Group category. Subsequently, they are deemed be to Significant      Beneficial Owners pursuant to Section 90 of the Companies Act, 2013 for      the various Charitable/Discretionary Trusts, which holds shares in the      Company and of which they are one of the Trustees. The details relating to the date of creation/acquisition of significant beneficial interest by the Significant Beneficial Owner is on the basis of intimations received from the Promoters of the Company.
